I've ported the server to Go, and it passes all 4 example cases in `node check.mjs`. The race-detector unit tests also pass.

- **Structure:** it uses Go's standard `net/http` with no third-party packages. Its built-in HTTP handling replaces the hand-written socket and HTTP parsing in the C++ version, and keeps the same limits: 64 KiB of headers and a 10-second I/O timeout. Values over 1 MiB get `413`.
- **Files:** `main.go` (port argument, server setup), `handler.go` (routes, key checks, `405`
